sampleDomainMetrics: near-end correlation, level preservation and unexplained residual
input AGC target, gain, slew, peak and clipped fraction
lifecycleReceipts: route generation and zero commit during reconfigure
device loss, missing reference, effect failure and overrun
exact 2-percent packet-loss trace and zero post-cancel emission

artifactPolicy.fixtureAudio: generated non-speech synthetic float32 only; not committed
artifactPolicy.candidateAudio: delete after report hashing unless retained as explicitly synthetic CI evidence
artifactPolicy.report: content-free aggregate metrics, categorical failures, hashes and toolchain receipt

limitations: deterministic correlation is a CI destruction sentinel and does not replace canonical STOI
synthetic runtime receipts test evaluator behavior and are not physical CPU, memory or latency evidence
no signed app, physical route, acoustic echo path, blinded listening or accessibility result is claimed
